step2_static_metadata.description: Detect allele-specific chromatin accessibility from ATAC-seq using WASP, GATK ASEReadCounter, or RASQUAL. Use when mapping cis-regulatory genetic variants from heterozygous SNPs, validating GWAS variant function with allelic imbalance, building a phased within-peak ASE analysis, or detecting reference-allele mapping bias before downstream analysis.
